Module com.ecotwin
Package com.ecotwin.controller

Class ScenariosController

java.lang.Object
com.ecotwin.controller.ScenariosController
public class ScenariosController extends Object
US-27: Create a temporary sustainability scenario. Scenario values are copied from current household data and can be changed without changing the household's real resource records. US-28: the scenario's score is shown beside the current score. US-29/30/31: scenarios can be saved, reopened and deleted.
